<function name="IsPlayerSpeaking" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<added>2026.08.12</added>
	<description>
		<internal></internal>
	Determines whether a player is currently speaking. 

Alias : <page>Player:IsSpeaking</page> (clientside).
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		# The argument name must be changed.
		<arg name="UserID" type="number"></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="IsSpeaking" type="boolean">Returns true if the player is currently speaking, false otherwise.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
